note: Rhythm/position rules JSON Schema cannot express. Every rule id here is implemented in schema/semantic_validate.py with the same severity (verify_all GRAPH_AGREEMENT).

rules.rule: The PageSpec's node sequence (section#variant) must match its declared template's node list (required/repeatable/min/max/variants); the template id is cross-referenced, never nodes[] in isolation.
Promo marquee (if any) then navbar open the page; the footer closes the in-flow content; only overlays may follow the footer.
Navbar variant 'sticky' exactly when the promo marquee is present (homepage shell); every other page uses 'fixed' with no marquee (src/routes.js SHELLS).
Exactly one HERO node per page, except hero-less templates.
The hero is the first non-shell node, except an optional campaign banner may precede it.
A section may not appear more often than its contract's maxPerPage (max observed on any route).
Two adjacent nodes may not have the same section AND variant (split rows legitimately repeat with alternating variants).
Overlay nodes (dialogs) come after the footer.
Template T0 (home) is valid only on '/', and '/' only on T0.
A reference-mode PageSpec's route must be a served route mapped to the same template in routes/routes.json.
A node's retrievalEligible flag (if set) must equal the pinned value for its section.
The last in-flow content node should be CTA, CONVERSION or FAQ (every served route ends that way).
No more than 3 sections with required autoplaying motion on one page (the busiest served page has 3).
